collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: By firelight, a child makes shadow animals dance across the wall of the hut.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: By firelight, (name1), a child, makes shadow animals dance across the wall of the hut. The shadow bird flaps so well that a younger sibling tries to catch it.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: By firelight, (name1), a child, makes shadow animals dance across the wall of the hut. A parent joins in with a shadow fish that swallows the shadow bird.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: By firelight, (name1), a child, makes shadow animals dance across the wall of the hut. The child invents an animal nobody can name, and everyone guesses.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: By firelight, (name1), a child, makes shadow animals dance across the wall of the hut. The fire burns low, and the animals fade away one by one.
